statement: Changelog wording a reviewer prescribes is itself a claim, and can be broader than the code. The cejel 0.6.4 prep goal prescribed that comparisons whose left-hand name 'contains hmac, signature or mac' stay covered (#430). The pattern matches mac only at the start of a word (\bmac), unchanged since v0.6.3. A probe of the live pattern flagged mac, macValue and req.mac, but not expectedMac or expected_mac, so the sentence was corrected to 'begins with mac'. Rule: before committing a coverage sentence, run the live pattern on inputs either side of every term, including terms the change did not touch.

A check's absolute result is only meaningful in the environment it was measured in. For 'no new failure', run the check on the unmodified base tree in the same environment and compare line sets. Preparing cejel 0.6.4, check-cited-commits reported 377 failures locally on the release branch. The expected value stated in advance was 0, taken from the #464 inventory. Fetching refs/pull/*/head and tags as CI does did not change the count, and unmodified origin/main gave the same 377 failures. The FAIL, PENDING and ERRATUM line sets were identical: 0 new, 0 gone. Rule: when an expected value comes from CI or a record, measure the base in your own environment before reading the branch result as a pass or a regression.
